coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters of the printed PDF (monospace text: every place is the box of its own characters, found by pattern on its line); every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays looked at.

third_parties: registered representative and office manager of the selling agent (page 7, Items 10 and 11)
signing.kind: A subscription agreement and power of attorney signature page printed as plain text (combs "|_|", text tick boxes "/ /", hyphen and underscore lines). The investor signs (left column) or a fiduciary, trustee, partner or officer signs for an entity (right column); a joint investor signs under the investor. The registered representative and office manager sign Item 10. No acceptance block for the trust is printed. A request for redemption form follows (pages 7-9), completed by a unitholder only when redeeming.
signing.individual_and_entity: separated only in the Item 9 signature block (left: investor and joint investor; right: authorised fiduciary, trustee, partner or corporate officer)
